rationale.plugin: Required-column diagnostic only; retain ERP aliases, no parser data or forecast/order changes.
rationale.csv: Separate non-file diagnostic and required-column diagnostic only; retain local-file size contract.
rationale.smartImport: Deduplicate set-aside display rows by physical sheet/row; no parsed inventory data change.

plugin.before: if(!['sku','name','on_hand'].every(f=>f in picked))throw new CsvError('CSV columns must begin: sku,name,unit,on_hand,supplier_days. Common ERP names also work, e.g. Item Code, Item Name, UoM, Qty On Hand, Lead Time.')
plugin.after: if(!['sku','name','on_hand'].every(f=>f in picked)){const missing=[['sku','product code'],['name','product name'],['on_hand','stock on hand']].filter(([field])=>!(field in picked)).map(([,label])=>label);throw new CsvError(`CSV is missing required ${missing.join(', ')} column${missing.length===1?'':'s'}. Required columns are product code, product name and stock on hand; unit and supplier lead time are optional. Common ERP names also work, e.g. Item Code, Item Name, UoM, Qty On Hand, Lead Time.`)}

csv.before: if not p.is_file() or p.stat().st_size > max_bytes:
raise SourceError('CSV columns must begin: sku,name,unit,on_hand,supplier_days. Common ERP names also work, e.g. Item Code, Item Name, UoM, Qty On Hand, Lead Time.')
csv.after:
missing = [label for field, label in (('sku', 'product code'), ('name', 'product name'), ('on_hand', 'stock on hand')) if field not in picked]
        raise SourceError('CSV is missing required ' + ', '.join(missing) + ' column' + ('' if len(missing) == 1 else 's') + '. Required columns are product code, product name and stock on hand; unit and supplier lead time are optional. Common ERP names also work, e.g. Item Code, Item Name, UoM, Qty On Hand, Lead Time.')
